You have taken a quest. Its goals and progress are shown in .quests and on the Community Board (Bounties and Requests), where you can also abandon it.

Party: everyone in your party who stays near you takes part and is paid. Stay together for most of the quest.

Bonuses: optional goals, finishing quickly or with no one dying raise the reward. A follow-up quest may come after a good finish.

Failing costs you nothing: the quest just ends. A quest you turn down or fail is not offered again the same day.

Tired of heralds? .quests heralds off stops the offers that come unasked.
